title: French tour of Miami in convertible mustang
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our tour is characterized by the fact of presenting you all the districts of Miami with their history and especially to discover them by places where nobody goes.

In the majority of our stops, you will be surprised by the often unexpected places.

The visit by convertible mustang makes it possible not to miss anything of the places, and increases the possibilities of moving from one district to another very easily.

The visit can be made à la carte by choosing the neighborhoods you want.
